_comment: What a word says, and asking where someone is (Words.java, Whereabouts.java). In word.msg.* lines (what's written or said) {who} is whom it's for, {town} their town, {mine} the sender's town, {news} something of the sender's town lately, {dead} who died, {cause} how, {enemy} who they're at war with, {wanted} someone wanted, {crime} what for, {thing} what's run out, {owed} a sum. In the rest {player} is what it calls you, {who} the person, {way} a direction, {far} how far, {place} a place, {job} a line of work.
